d: The new season at Bondi introduces fresh faces with trainee Ryan, Maxi's cousin, who struggles with the megaphone. New recruit Chris from Western Australia faces a life-and-death situation. Mario tackles his first mass rescue on the jet ski. Young Jethro hits it off with a pair of drag queens.

On the day of the lifeguard challenge, Max and Jesse chase an inflatable boat ride, leading to further trouble when Jesse gets a buoy rope stuck in the jetski intake. The lifeguards deal with tourists using cheap boogie boards whose arm leashes break, causing them to quickly sink in deep water.

On New Year's Eve, lifeguards Harries and Kerrbox contend with drunk swimmers. Backpackers steal the lifeguard buggy. A shark sighting leads to the evacuation of a crowd of 40,010 people from the water. Chaos ensues when a woman reports her baby abducted by another woman.

A woman walks naked on the beach, discarding towels offered by Harries before strolling onto the Bondi streets. Another woman is removed by police for drunkenly harassing beachgoers. And lifeguards build the wildest boats imaginable for the end of season 'Surf-en-tag' wave riding competition."
Jesse saves an American tourist from calm waters, combined with a collective CPR effort from the lifeguards, the paramedics, and the Jewish Medical Response team.

Bondi's chiselled lifeguards get a run for their money when all-male-revue Manpower Australia make a surprise visit. A colourful Bondi local is found facedown and unresponsive in the sand. Singlets races to a rescue in the buggy but faces obstacles with flocks of seagulls.

Bondi's new trainee is a member of Maroubra's Bra Boys, trying to turn over a new leaf whilst on a suspended jail sentence. The surf club rescue boat has a spectacular 'upside-down' collision with a reef. Even morphine can't stop a young boy's painful howls when he suffers a mystery stomach illness.

In the most powerful episode ever, two people from the same family drown. The remaining family members watch as lifeguards attempt to resuscitate them, marking a crisis not faced by lifeguards since 1939.

Bondi faces a bluebottle invasion. Lifeguards treat a boy from the UK stung by the painful creatures. Singlets attends a suspected spinal injury, shocked to find that the patient is his son, Star recruit Clint Kimmins uses his big wave surfing skills for a daring rescue of a drowning man.

Chappo and H-man cautiously prepare a 19 year old German tourist for hospital after he's broken his back. Trainees Taco and Jesse have a difficult day in class struggling with the books, but get a chance to make the grade against the rest of the team in the annual lifeguard challenge.

In soaring temperatures, a 2-year-old girl is trapped in a locked car. A mother and daughter are saved by a man who can barely swim himself. Lifeguards catch a bag thief, who sends them on a chase. Harrison must improvise for equipment when he spots swimmers going under after pack-up time.

On the hottest day ever in Bondi, tempers flare in the heat and a fight erupts on the beach. A blistering Northwest wind sweeps a couple and their boogie board half a kilometre out to sea. Terry encounters a man in excruciating pain after losing his boardies.

Chappo must decide which of three struggling swimmers to rescue first. Lifeguards use spotlights when Bondi hosts 15,010 World Pride Beach Party revellers. Hoppo celebrates his 30th year on the beach.
In a frenzied mass rescue, lifeguards search for a student who didn't make it back to the beach. Bagus and Hoppo witness an assault on a woman. Harrison makes a young fan cry - for the right reasons.

During storm season, a tornado hits Southern Sydney. Tourists brave the waves at Bondi. Jesse, alone in the tower, can't assist a drowning man as all lifeguards are busy in the water. Two thrill-seekers encounter trouble in the big swell, and a British rapper embraces the storm to feel the music.
